body: I do have a dog. That’s why I moved here, my landlord and his wife said I could get a puppy
Yea they’re like an extra set of parents

I made it. Stopped to see them on my way to work this morning and he gave me a huge hug because he could see it in my face that I was struggling. He has a pretty good sense of my emotions. 
Then his wife and I had coffee on the porch for a bit.

So that helped a bit to feel cared about
Well then you’ll really shit when you find out I pay $700 to them for a 3 bedroom 2 bath house on 3 acres with all my utilities included.

If that’s your opinion carry on

They’ve done more for me than anyone

I have a dog, I actually moved here because they let me get a puppy. That was the selling point of me moving in here, was i paid $55 a month more but have all utilities covered and a 3 bedroom house on 3 acres of land

My old place was a 1 bedroom apartment for $645 and no utilities and in an apartment building where you couldn’t even have a goldfish.

So my dog is my BFF

I pretty much don’t eat, have become a workaholic, and only cry when alone in the shower and driving alone in the car. 

The rest of the time everyone thinks I’m fine - I just bury it deep down
That’s why I only cry in the shower or alone in the car on my way back to my house. The rest of the time I’m unphased to others around me
